prompt:
Create a polished hand-painted 2D game CHARACTER MODEL SHEET with TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. The attached CC0 MakeHuman anatomy reference is ONLY to ensure human anatomy, continuous torso, two arms/two legs, actual hands, elbows/knees. Do not reproduce the reference chart, labels, gray clay or realistic proportions.

This is an ORIGINAL adult male fortress hammer warrior for a refined fantasy tower-defense game. Anatomically readable, compact exactly approximately 3.5 heads tall, stocky capable grown man aged 35-45, broad shoulders, square face with visible nose, small confident eyes, dark swept hair with a single silver forelock on his anatomical RIGHT side, short dark beard; serious but approachable. Blue-gray fitted plate armor #405469, controlled cool gray highlights #8f9ba5, warm copper edge trim #b27a4d, burgundy scarf #682639, dark brown leather belt/gloves/boots, ivory undershirt. Broad overlapping shoulder plates, layered leather skirt over trousers. Full fingers encircling hammer handle, thumb opposing fingers; free hand complete and relaxed in a guard. Restrained ornament, copper rivets, decisive colored outlines varying line weight, 3 designed cel-painted shadow values with a little painterly edge texture, readable at 96px. NO 3D plastic rendering, no faceless mannequin, no geometric body parts, no photorealism, no super-deformed baby. One oversized bevel-edged rectangular iron-and-copper SINGLE-HANDED war hammer with wood handle, copper end caps, one small engraved fortress insignia on head.

Exact composition is a square 2x2 invisible grid. All content isolated on transparency; no panels, text, numbers, labels, ground shadows, frames, glows or backdrop.
UPPER LEFT cell: whole warrior holding hammer in anatomical RIGHT hand, three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT, slightly overhead 12-degree orthographic game view, both boots visible and complete, readable separation of limbs, compact 3.5 head proportion.
UPPER RIGHT cell: same exact warrior, independently drawn opposite three-quarter view facing screen LEFT, SAME anatomical right hand holding SAME hammer, SAME silver forelock and costume identity, not a simple mirror that swaps right/left handedness. Both character drawings same scale. Leave comfortable margin for every hammer, hair and boot.
LOWER LEFT cell: ONLY the same rectangular iron-copper hammer, detached asset, large upright vertical view, no hand, centered with handle below.
LOWER RIGHT cell: ONLY a second original single-handed hammer design with a rounded crescent-shaped copper hammer-head, short steel center and matching dark wood wrapped grip, large upright detached asset, no hand.
Upper characters occupy about75 percent each cell height. Lower weapon assets about65percent cell height. Highest possible square resolution. Commercial-quality concept craft, designed 2D shapes.
reproducibility: Model version and seed not exposed; preserve original generated bytes.
visual_notes: Clear human design and full limbs.
Static concept is taller than 3.5 heads; motion illustrations must follow compact guide anatomy rather than copy this proportion.
Grid placement is approximate; static concept is not used as an animation atlas.
